subject: Status: shape-space retraining + hand articulation risk
body:
Hi Alina, Dmitri,

Status. The 16-dim nonlinear VAE shape space retrain finished on the reserved Vulcan slice - reconstruction error is 8% lower than the linear PCA basis at the same dimensionality, consistent with the original training loop. Facial expression space (20-dim) retrains cleanly too. Saoirse's sampling API can now draw shape + pose + expression jointly, and GHUML(ite) samples render fast enough for the demo.

The risk I flagged earlier is real: hand-articulation closeups cover maybe a third of the poses we want to expose, so blend-skinning artifacts show up on extreme finger poses. Options: (a) restrict the launch asset to body + face and mark hands experimental, or (b) two more weeks of corrective training and we eat the schedule. Paloma's audit doc has the numbers.

I lean (a). Can we decide this week?

Quentin
